paragraphs.label: Nhận lời
paragraphs.text:

Thank you for inviting me to a flexible working discussion. I would love to come. I have been interested in flexible working hours for some time, so I am glad we will have a chance to explore it together.

paragraphs.label: Chuẩn bị và hỗ trợ
paragraphs.text: I understand that we will compare working schedules and plan shared team hours. I can bring a sample weekly schedule, but could you let me know if anything else is needed? One useful point is that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. For example, a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school. I would also be happy to help arrange the seats or hand out materials before the session begins.

Best wishes,
Minh
